_om: Slangen in English (Hissy, rusj.no/en/hissy/): snake. Key = the Norwegian text in spill.js. Shared words (Nytt spill, Alle spill …) come from rusj/kit/tekst.en.json.
Krasj! {poeng}. Sveip eller trykk på en: Crash! {poeng}. Swipe or tap an arrow to try again.
Press an arrow key to try again.
Sveip eller trykk på en pil for å starte: Swipe or tap an arrow to start.
Uten vegger: Ut på én side, inn på den a: No walls: out one side, in the other.
Styr slangen til maten. Hver bit gjør de: Steer the snake to the food. Every bite makes it longer – and space gets tighter.
Swipe on the board or tap the arrows. On a keyboard: the arrow keys or WASD.
Hver frukt gir ett poeng og gjør slangen: Each piece of fruit is worth one point and makes the snake one segment longer.
If the snake hits itself, it's game over. With walls, the edge is dangerous too – without walls, the snake comes out on the other side.
Sving i god tid. Du kan trykke to svinge: Turn in good time. You can tap two turns quickly one after the other, and the snake remembers both.
Hold deg langs kantene når slangen blir: Keep to the edges when the snake gets long, so you have room in the middle.
Spillet tar pause av seg selv hvis du by: The game pauses by itself if you switch apps. On a keyboard, space or P pauses.
Krasjet du? Sveip en gang til, så er en: Crashed? Swipe again and a new snake is off straight away. Beat your best and you'll see the full result.
Slangen går i sanntid og kan dessverre i: The snake moves in real time and sadly can't be played with a screen reader.
Bare ikke bit deg selv i halen!: Just don't bite your own tail!
If the snake hits the edge, it's game over.
The snake comes out on the other side.
Brettet med slangen og maten: The board with the snake and the food
Piltaster eller WASD styrer · mellomrom: Arrow keys or WASD to steer · space = pause
Brettet da spillet var slutt: The board when the game ended
Første runde med dette oppsettet – nå ha: Your first go with these settings – now you've got a score to beat!
Prøv igjen – slangen blir sulten på nytt: Try again – the snake's getting hungry again!
